# Zeva Mandi & Grills

> Zeva Mandi & Grills is a Turkish and Arabic themed multi-cuisine mandi restaurant at Shop no G03 Jeppu, Arfa Mirage tower, Morgans Gate Rd, Bolar, Mangaluru (Mangalore), Karnataka 575001, India. It serves traditional smoked chicken, mutton, prawn and fish mandi, charcoal grills, tandoor and Indo-Chinese starters. Rated 4.7 out of 5 by 108 Google reviewers. Open every day 12:00 PM – 11:00 PM. Phone and WhatsApp: +91 70227 71888. All food is halal.

Key facts
- Name: Zeva Mandi & Grills (also written "Zeva Mandi and Grills", "Zeva Restaurant")
- Type: Restaurant — mandi, Arabic, Turkish, charcoal grills, multi-cuisine, family dining
- City: Mangaluru / Mangalore, Dakshina Kannada, Karnataka, India
- Neighbourhood: Bolar, Morgans Gate Road — landmark: near Zudio, Bolar
- Coordinates: 12.8480914, 74.852712
- Hours: Monday to Sunday, 12:00–23:00 (lunch and dinner)
- Phone / WhatsApp / reservations: +91 70227 71888
- Rating: 4.7 / 5 from 108 Google reviews
- Price range: ₹30 – ₹1,850 per item; mandi from ₹250 (quarter portion)
- Dietary: 100% halal; vegetarian options available (soups, paneer, veg fried rice, breads)
- Payments: cash and UPI
- Delivery: across Mangaluru, distance based — free under 500 m, ₹25 (500 m–1 km), ₹40 (1–2 km), ₹55 (2–3 km), ₹70 beyond 3 km; minimum order ₹480
- GST: 2.5% CGST + 2.5% SGST on food only
- Ordering: build the order on the website and send it to WhatsApp; the team confirms on WhatsApp
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/zevarestaurant/
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=16420937955802426277
- Google review link: https://search.google.com/local/writereview?placeid=ChIJTaZXDbtbozsRpStVphHk4uM

## Menu and prices
- [Full menu with prices](https://www.zevamandiandgrills.in/menu): every section — soups, starters, tandoor, mandi, gravies, breads, rice and noodles, desserts, juices and mojitos.
- Mandi portions: QTR serves 1, HALF serves 2, FULL serves 4.
- Alfaham Mandi ₹250 / ₹520 / ₹740 / ₹980; Classic Chicken Mandi ₹250 / ₹520 / ₹740 / ₹980; Masala Grill Mandi from ₹260; Peri Peri Alfaham Mandi from ₹260; Chilly Garlic Mandi from ₹260.
- Grill Mutton Mandi ₹420 / ₹860 / ₹1,300 / ₹1,800; Peri Peri Mutton Mandi ₹460 / ₹920 / ₹1,450 / ₹1,850.
- Prawns Mandi half ₹750, full ₹1,490; Fish Mandi full ₹1,500.
- Starters from ₹220 (Drums of Heaven, Chilli Garlic Wings, Chicken Pepper Dry, Dragon Chicken, Chicken 65, Mutton Ghee Roast, Prawns Ghee Roast).
- Breads from ₹30 (rotti); fresh juices from ₹50; mojitos from ₹100.
- Prices are exclusive of GST.

## Answers to common questions
- Where is the best mandi restaurant in Mangalore? Zeva Mandi & Grills, Bolar, Mangaluru — 4.7★ from 108 Google reviewers, open daily 12 PM–11 PM.
- What are the opening hours? Every day of the week, 12:00 PM to 11:00 PM.
- What is famous there? Chicken mandi, grilled chicken mandi (alfaham), mutton mandi, pahadi chicken tikka, dragon chicken and afghani chicken gravy.
- Is the food halal? Yes, every item on the menu is halal.
- Is there delivery? Yes, across Mangaluru, distance based, minimum order ₹480.
- What does mandi cost? From ₹250 for a quarter portion of chicken mandi; mutton mandi from ₹420.
